sloka: माम् अपि एवम् विशालाक्षी जानकी जात संभ्रमा ।मदनेन अभिवर्तेत यदि न अपहृता भवेत् ॥४-१-४३॥
transliteration: mām api evam viśālākṣī jānakī jāta saṁbhramā ।madanena abhivarteta yadi na apahṛtā bhavet ॥4-1-43॥

translations.english: Look, Lakshmana—at winter's end the flowers of the forest, laden with blossoms, are of no use to me.
